caption_L1: Median hourly wages of selected occupations in radio and TV broadcasting as of May 2019 (in U.S. dollars) is a bar graph. There is a categorical scale with Advertising sales agents on one end and Radio and telecommunications equipment installers and repairers at the other on the y-axis, marked Occupation. Median hourly wage in U.S. dollars is plotted as a linear scale of range 0 to 50 on the x-axis.
caption_L2L3: General and operations managers where the highest earners at over 50 per hour compared to just 15 per hour for office clerks and broadcast announcers.  The average wage was closer to around 20 per hour with nearly all employees close to this income region.  The large outlier was the general and operation managers who early over double the average level.
